meaning:
1) (Niphal) to be negligent
2) (Hiphil) to mislead
Aramaic equivalent: sha.lah (שָׁלָה "error" H7955)

elsewhere.note: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”
My sons, don’t be negligent now; for Yahweh has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers, and burn incense.”
